name: DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-32B
attention_variant: GQA (standard; sliding_window set to full 131072 = inactive)
notes: The important contrast case for this repo: an R1-family model with plain dense GQA and no MLA at all. kv_cache_bytes_per_token = 64 layers x 8 kv_heads x head_dim 128 x 2 (K and V) x 2 bytes (bf16) = 64 x 8 x 128 x 2 x 2 = 262,144 B/token (256 KiB). head_dim is NOT in config.json; it is 5120/40 = 128 (hidden_size / num_attention_heads), which is the standard Qwen2 derivation. At 3.7x DeepSeek-V3's KV per token (256 KiB vs 68.6 KiB) despite roughly comparable active params, this is why distills run out of KV memory long before they run out of FLOPs. Architecture Qwen2ForCausalLM (model_type qwen2): hidden 5120, 64 layers, 40 heads / 8 kv heads (gqa_ratio 5), intermediate 27648. sliding_window is set to 131072, equal to max_position_embeddings, i.e. the sliding window is disabled in practice. rope_theta 1000000. Context 131072.
